arms.S: relation write from the fixed structure only: e^{l+1}=BN_e(e^l+O_e xi_static)

only_difference: the input of the relation write (xi vs xi_static); identical parameters, token layers, reader, loss, recipe

architecture.bn_scope: real tokens / real pairs only, no padding

initialization.d_s_identity: identical keys, shapes and tensors; only the arm flag differs
